name: AI Interview Assistant for Job Seekers

mentions.name: AI Interview Assistant for Job Seekers
mentions.description: An AI interview assistant that represents job candidates in first-round job interviews. It ingests candidate information (CV, professional experience, cover letter, LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio, and preferences such as salary expectations, location, and contract type), then conducts automated interviews directly with HR departments or their chatbots. In real time it generates responses in the candidate's own style with soft skills and structured answers, and pings the candidate for input when it encounters questions beyond its knowledge. Features include 24/7 availability, personalized responses, post-interview performance analytics on how well the candidate matched job requirements, and a training mode for practicing interview scenarios with feedback.
mentions.problem: Companies screen candidates with automated systems and generic chatbots, and interviews are hard to attend while sleeping or working a current job; this lets candidates fight fire with fire by sending an AI to the first interview round on their behalf.
mentions.source_excerpt: So, I've been working on something... interesting. It's an AI assistant that can actually represent candidates in the first round of job interviews.
